classes.name: correspondent
classes.label: correspondent
classes.definition: A bank, brokerage or other financial institution that is not a direct DTC member. Correspondents rely on direct DTC Participants to perform their DTC settlement services

classes.name: d t c c member
classes.label: d t c c member
classes.definition: A firm which is a member of DTCC. Note: this Actor may perform any of the Roles described elsewhere in this Issuance model, i.e. the DTCC Member may also be any of the Actors defined. REVIEW: does this apply to ALL the defined Actor types?

classes.name: debt issue over allotment terms
classes.label: debt issue over allotment terms
classes.definition: Terms for Change to an Issue Amount for Debt securities

classes.name: issuance closing
classes.label: issuance closing
classes.definition: The process of crediting the DTC participant account on settlement date with the position for the new issue. The overall closing process includes the exchange of funds that happens outside of DTC.

classes.name: issue over allotment terms
classes.label: issue over allotment terms
classes.definition: Terms for Change to an Issue Amount. A provision in an underwriting agreement, which allows members of the underwriting syndicate to purchase additional shares at the original price.

classes.name: muni debt offering
classes.label: muni debt offering
classes.definition: The process step of offering a Municipal Debt security for issue.

classes.name: potential muni underwriter
classes.label: potential muni underwriter
classes.definition: An intermediary between an issuer of a security and the investing public. An underwriter can either be DTC Participant or Correspondent who would clear the underwriting deal using the Crediting Participant.

classes.name: securities underwriting issuance
classes.label: securities underwriting issuance
classes.definition: Underwriting, as a method of Securities Issuance.

classes.name: securities underwriting issuance process
classes.label: securities underwriting issuance process
classes.definition: The process by which debt instruments are offered to the market by a syndicate of underwriters who underwrite the issue.

classes.name: underwriting process actor
classes.label: underwriting process actor
classes.definition: any actor within the DTCC Underwriting Process or any other Underwriting Process. Note: At present all these Actors (e.g. Underwriter) are defined simply as Process Actors and not as specializations of this type of Actor. Therefore this Actor is a Union of all of those.

edges.name: actual closing date
edges.label: actual closing date
edges.definition: The date in which closing has been done for the underwriter of a security.

edges.name: dissemination decision date and time
edges.label: dissemination decision date and time
edges.definition: Date and Time when the Dissemination Underwriter made the Decision about Dissemination.

edges.name: formal award date and time
edges.label: formal award date and time
edges.definition: Date and time the issuer formally accepts a bid for Competitive Issues or, the Date and Time the Bond Purchase Agreement is executed for Negotiated Issues. Time Zone: Include in date/time data or add a term for it?

edges.name: issuance settlement date
edges.label: issuance settlement date
edges.definition: Settlement date for the initial Issuance transaction.

edges.name: maximum over allotment amount
edges.label: maximum over allotment amount
edges.definition: The maximum amount that is available as part of providing the over-allotment option.

edges.name: maximum over allotment percentage
edges.label: maximum over allotment percentage
edges.definition: The percentage that is available as part of providing the over-allotment option.

edges.name: subscribes to
edges.label: subscribes to
edges.definition: Subscriber responds to marketing / draft propspectus, indicates interest and is allocated shares / debt units based on interest.

attributes.name: announcement comments
attributes.label: announcement comments
attributes.definition: Free form description of Purpose of Issue, Source of funds etc.

attributes.name: maximum over allotment shares
attributes.label: maximum over allotment shares
attributes.definition: The maximum amount of shares that are available as part of providing the over-allotment option.

attributes.name: over allotment available
attributes.label: over allotment available
attributes.definition: Whether an over-allotment option is available for the security.

attributes.name: over allotment expiry period days
attributes.label: over allotment expiry period days
attributes.definition: Number of calendar days after the closing of initial offering for expiry of over-allotment option.
